project_name: Snooker Club Salto - Awwwards Marketing Site Blueprint

client_identity.location: Rua John Kennedy, 379 - Bela Vista, Salto/SP, Brasil
client_identity.design_archetype: English Snooker Hall at Night (Dark Modern + Classic British Luxury)
client_identity.aesthetic_synthesis: Dark navy felt surface depth paired with rich mahogany wood textures, brass/gold precision accents, crimson tournament highlights, and high-contrast editorial typography.

heading_font.name: Cormorant Garamond
heading_font.usage: H1, H2, H3, Section Hero Titles, Manifesto Headings

subheading_font.name: Cinzel
subheading_font.usage: Overlines, Category Badges, Chapter Numbers, Tournament Headers, Trophy Titles

body_font.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
body_font.usage: Body narrative, form controls, table data, UI buttons, meta info

scale.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#d4af37]

visual_enhancers.spotlight_gradient: radial-gradient(600px circle at var(--mouse-x, 50%) var(--mouse-y, 50%), rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08), transparent 80%)

sections_breakdown.name: Navegação Principal (Header & Floating Bar)
sections_breakdown.description: Sticky glassmorphism nav bar with gold inner hairline border, live open badge indicator, language/club status, links, and direct CTA 'Reservar Mesa'.
components: Live Status Badge: 'ABERTO AGORA' (Green Pulse) / 'FECHADO NO MOMENTO' (Crimson Muted)
Admin Key trigger icon (opens password dialog)

sections_breakdown.name: Hero Section & Kinetic Mask Reveal
sections_breakdown.description: Line-by-line kinetic reveal animation. High-impact dark backdrop with spotlight overhead pool lamp effect. Features main headline in Portuguese, key club statistics counter, and dual action buttons.
sections_breakdown.headline: A Tradição do Snooker Inglês no Coração de Salto
sections_breakdown.subheadline: Mesa profissional de feltro nobre, tacos balanceados e a atmosfera perfeita para quem joga por paixão e precisão.

sections_breakdown.name: Fita Editorial em Movimento (Editorial Marquee)
sections_breakdown.description: Slow, elegant drift with low-contrast warm text separated by gold pool ball icons.
phrases: MESA PROFISSIONAL TACO DE MADEIRA NOBRE
O PONTO DE ENCONTRO DOS AMANTES DA SINUCA EM SALTO-SP

sections_breakdown.name: O Manifesto da Sinuca de Elite (Numbered Chapters)
sections_breakdown.description: Asymmetric 3-column bento layout detailing the club's philosophy through numbered chapters.

chapters.title: A Geometria da Tacada Perfeita
chapters.text: Cada ângulo é medido, cada efeito calculado. No Salto Snooker Club, a mesa é um santuário de precisão.

chapters.title: A Tradição do Feltro Verde
chapters.text: Feltro importado de altíssima gramatura que garante o deslize impecável das esferas de resina fenólica.

chapters.title: Camaradagem & Competição
chapters.text: Um ambiente clássico inglês feito para desfrutar boas conversas, partidas acirradas e grandes amizades.

sections_breakdown.name: Seção de Campeonatos (Backend Dynamic Feed + Registration Modal)
sections_breakdown.description: Fetches current tournaments from backend `/api/championships`. Features status badges ('Inscrições Abertas', 'Em Andamento', 'Finalizado'), prize pool details, date cards, and an interactive Registration Modal.
sections_breakdown.registration_flow: User fills registration form -> Form validates data -> On submit, generates WhatsApp deep link encoded message sent to +55 11 98515-7388.

sections_breakdown.name: Canal Ao Vivo - Kauã da Sinuquinha
sections_breakdown.description: Integration highlight for channel 'Kauã da Sinuquinha'. Dark video showcase cards with golden live badges, embedded play previews, and subscriber call-to-action.

sections_breakdown.name: Galeria do Clube & Fotos Profissionais
sections_breakdown.description: Interactive light-box photo gallery with filter tabs ('Todas', 'Ambiente Clássico', 'Mesas & Equipamentos', 'Torneios').

gallery_images.title: Tacos Selecionados em Suporte de Madeira

sections_breakdown.name: Horário de Funcionamento & Localização (Google Maps)
sections_breakdown.description: Grid box featuring calculated live open status based on Salto/SP timezone (UTC-3), schedule list, address details, interactive directions CTA, and embedded dark-styled Google Maps iframe/card.
sections_breakdown.address: Rua John Kennedy, 379 - Bela Vista, Salto/SP

sections_breakdown.name: Botão Flutuante do WhatsApp
sections_breakdown.description: Sticky bottom-right action trigger (+55 11 98515-7388) styled with pulse animation, crimson/gold accent trim, and quick popup drawer with pre-written options.
sections_breakdown.default_message: Olá! Gostaria de informações sobre o Snooker Club Salto e reserva de mesas.

sections_breakdown.name: Área de Administração Protegida (Gestão de Campeonatos)
sections_breakdown.description: Dialog triggered via header key/icon or secret route footer link. Protected by password challenge. Allows creating, editing, and deleting championships dynamically.

universal_guidelines: Always tint background darks with navy tone #0d1230 instead of plain pure black #000000.
Maintain high APCA contrast for body text using #f7f4ee warm off-white.
Do not use generic Bootstrap columns; mix bento grids with asymmetric cards.
Ensure every interactive element features hover states and data-testid attributes.
Use smooth scrolling via Lenis and framer-motion reveals throughout the entire marketing flow.
